item.title: Copper Pickaxe
item.description: The Copper Pickaxe is the first mining tool in Core Keeper, crafted at the Copper Workbench. It mines copper and tin ore efficiently and is the natural upgrade from the starting tools. Use Mines Copper Ore and Tin Ore Upgrades to the Tin Pickaxe for iron mining

item.title: Iron Pickaxe
item.description: The Iron Pickaxe is the tier-3 mining tool in Core Keeper, crafted at the Iron Workbench after you reach The Forgotten Ruins. It unlocks gold and scarlet ore mining, the gateway to late-early-game equipment. Use Mines Gold Ore and Scarlet Ore Faster on earlier ores than the Tin Pickaxe Required before the first three bosses for the recommended Iron gear tier Crafting path Copper Pickaxe → mine Tin in The Clay Caves Tin Pickaxe → mine Iron in The Forgotten Ruins Iron Pickaxe → mine Gold / Scarlet for Iron-tier equipment
